name: Generic API Key
summary: Detects generic API keys with explicit context (api_key:, apiKey:, x-api-key:, API token, API service token, service token)
description:
Detects generic API keys and tokens with explicit label context. Matches values following api_key:, apiKey:, x-api-key:, 'api token', 'api service token', or 'service token' labels. 20-64 character alphanumeric strings.

Note: Generic pattern - may need context-specific tuning

Note: Overlaps with digital_identity.generic_api_key. The credentials/ version is canonical for secret detection; digital_identity/ version retained for category-based policy inclusion.

effect.message: API key tokenized with reversible mapping for audit trail
